d: Tamar can't join because she's promoting her single in NYC. Toni realizes there's tension between Tamar and the other sisters.
Toni asks her sisters to perform with her in St. Lucia while Gabe gets a makeover from Evelyn to prove to Trina he's a changed man.
The sisters visit Toni on her movie set in Canada. They sight-see and try to bond, but after a fight, Tamar leaves. Tamar and Towanda discuss their issues.
The Braxtons go on vacation in St. Lucia where Toni performs on stage with her sisters. Trina surprises the family with an impromptu vow renewal ceremony.
Tamar promotes her new Single and shoots a music video. Meanwhile, the sisters call an emergency therapy session to address their issues.
After the sisters' explosive therapy session, Michael Braxton attempts to reunite them. Traci deals with her husband's health scare.
The sisters call a truce. Towanda confronts Toni about recent press saying she's quitting the music biz. Traci struggles with a speech.
Tempers flare between the girls and their "ratchet" relatives at Papa Braxton's birthday bash. Toni meets with Babyface to discuss her music career.
Babyface lures Toni back in the studio, and Trina embarrasses Toni at celebrity charity event. Gabe gives Trina a new ring.
Tamar shocks the family with the news of her pregnancy. Trina records a new song and shops for a house in LA. The sisters have a cook-off.
